    tail: NODE[T]?

    add_to_head(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let added =
            if let first = head then
                first.insert_before(value)
            else
                NODE[T](value)
            fi

        if !tail? then
            tail = added
        fi

        head = added

        added
    si

    add_to_tail(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let added =
            if let last = tail then
                last.insert_after(value)
            else
                NODE[T](value)

        if !head? then
            head = added
        fi

        tail = added

        if existing == tail then
            tail = added
        fi

        let cursor mut = head

        while let node = cursor do
            yield node.value
            cursor = node.next
